trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies on your save, combining the campaign with completion and cleanup. Protect the Chapter 1 meditation before committing to the roughly 200-hour route. The platinum itself has no separate missable action.
steps: Protect the Chapter 1 meditation save.
Finish the story, completion checklist and remaining awards.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening assignment Gone Fishing and follow its objectives to the conclusion. This campaign award arrives through normal story progress. No optional medal or difficulty setting is required, and it is not missable.
steps: Start the opening mission Gone Fishing.
Finish its story objectives.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Follow the main assignments to the end of Chapter 1 for this automatic award. Before leaving the chapter, join Lucia for the balcony meditation after Down to Earth. Retain that early manual save for Positive Mental Attitude, although the chapter trophy itself cannot be missed.
steps: After Down to Earth, protect the morning balcony encounter.
Keep a Chapter 1 save and finish the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Continue through the main assignments until Chapter 2 concludes. Along the way, Daily Driver opens garage purchases and Moses opens vehicle registration. Those unlocks help later cleanup; this chapter award is automatic and not missable.
steps: Progress through Chapter 2's main assignments.
Complete the chapter and retain a boundary save.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's main sequence to earn the automatic chapter trophy. Save before Race Against Yago and do the optional race when its hourglass icon appears. That strand is time-sensitive, even though the chapter award is not missable.
steps: Save and race Yago when the hourglass appears.
Finish the main Chapter 3 sequence.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Advance the campaign through the end of Chapter 4 for this story award. Near the end, That's Where The Money Is unlocks optional vault jobs for later trophies. Keep a chapter-boundary save; the chapter trophy itself is not missable.
steps: Work through the main Chapter 4 missions.
Finish the chapter; take That's Where The Money Is for vault access.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Progress through all five chapters and complete the final main mission. Make a separate manual save before the finale as a precaution for your overall route. This automatic story award is not missable; remaining cleanup is available afterward.
steps: Keep a manual save before the finale.
Complete the last main mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Follow the main campaign until Breakfast Run becomes available, then complete the assignment. Its award is tied to ordinary mission completion rather than an optional challenge. There is no separate missable condition to protect.
steps: Advance the campaign to Breakfast Run.
Complete the mission objectives.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Continue the main story to The Cartel Heist and finish its objectives. The trophy follows mission completion, with no mission medal or difficulty target attached. It is a normal campaign unlock rather than a missable side activity.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist through story progress.
Finish the assignment.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the campaign until it leads to Child's Play and complete that mission. Normal completion supplies this award without an optional performance objective. Continue the story normally, since this trophy has no missable branch.
steps: Follow the campaign to Child's Play.
Complete its main objectives.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Reach Headliners by continuing the campaign, then finish the mission. There is no medal threshold to replay for this story award. It cannot be missed through ordinary campaign progression, so concentrate on the mission objectives.
steps: Reach Headliners in the campaign.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown when the main campaign reaches it. This automatic award is separate from stealing a passenger plane at the airport for Catch Me If You Can. There is no additional missable action for this mission trophy.
steps: Follow the story to VCIA Takedown.
Finish the mission rather than pursuing the separate free-roam plane trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Follow the story chain to Operation Savage Glory and complete the assignment. Ordinary mission completion is sufficient, without a separate combat medal requirement. This is not the free-roam Rhino challenge, and it is not missable.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory through campaign progress.
Finish the assignment.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the finale, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; earlier work already counts. Start with robberies and fencing to fund gear, then follow the roadmap's collectible and activity counts. The trophy thresholds are not always the completion thresholds: meditations need 15 here, while their own trophy needs all 18. This completion award can be finished after the story.
steps: Finish the story and open the 100% Completion checklist.
Clear robberies and fencing, then collectibles and activities using the roadmap counts.
Check every remaining category in the in-game checklist.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Build the total using stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. All these stunt types contribute, so vary the activity instead of hunting only jumps. Reach 250 for this trophy, then continue to 300 for completion; free-roam cleanup remains available.
steps: Mix the qualifying stunt types while exploring.
Reach 250, then continue to 300 for 100%.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity categories rather than repeating one favorite activity. Keep a note of the types you have already sampled as you explore. This is available in post-story free roam, so unfinished types do not require an early save.
steps: Track the activity categories you sample.
Try each remaining type until all nine are covered.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit both shooting ranges and work toward gold in all 42 challenges between them. Return to challenges that still lack gold instead of repeating completed ones. The full set also meets the range requirement for 100%, and can be finished during cleanup.
steps: Visit both ranges and identify unfinished challenges.
Earn all 42 gold medals.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun venues. Repeating a win at one venue does not cover a different location. Continue toward all 42 drone time trials for completion after securing the location trophy; neither task is missable.
steps: Record a win at each of the 14 venues.
Continue through all 42 time trials for completion.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Choose races you have not yet won and build up 20 distinct victories. Multiple wins on the same course do not satisfy the different-races condition. Continue to 30 of the 40 races for completion, with remaining wins available after the story.
steps: Win 20 distinct races.
Extend the tally to 30 for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Enter Cal's fishing challenge and finish ahead of him. If the first attempt fails, return during optional-activity cleanup and try again. The research does not establish a precise fishing location, and this challenge is not flagged as missable.
steps: Take Cal's fishing challenge.
Win the challenge; retry during cleanup if necessary.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play an arcade game all the way through instead of merely beginning a session. One completed game satisfies the trophy. Separately, the completion checklist asks you to play all four video games, which can be done after the campaign.
steps: Start an arcade game.
Play through its completion; sample all four video games for 100%.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's optional assignments in sequence until his final mission is finished. The strand stays available after the campaign, so it can wait for cleanup. It has its own trophy and does not contribute to the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Complete Andy's preceding assignments.
Finish his finale during optional-story cleanup.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Keep returning to Kenton's optional assignments until the strand reaches its finale. Complete that last mission for the award. His storyline remains open after the main campaign, allowing you to finish it during cleanup without a chapter deadline.
steps: Follow Kenton's optional assignments in sequence.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's side missions and finish the last assignment in his strand. You can return after the campaign, since this finale is not missable. Billy's strand has a separate award and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Progress through Billy's optional missions.
Finish his finale without adding it to your eight-strand tally.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying stranger strands, checking the trophy counter after each finale. Andy, Billy and Tyrone do not count toward this total. Save before the Chapter 3 Race Against Yago and race when its hourglass appears; that strand is time-sensitive, while the trophy can otherwise be cleaned up later.
steps: Protect Yago's Chapter 3 hourglass race with a manual save.
Finish qualifying strands and verify the counter reaches eight.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Return to Randy's side-story assignments until his last mission becomes available. Finish that finale to earn the award. The strand remains accessible after the main story, so there is no need to rush it before a chapter boundary.
steps: Complete Randy's preceding side missions.
Return for his final assignment.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's preceding assignments and then complete his side-story finale. This remains possible after the main campaign. Keep it separate from the Strangers & Freaks tally, because Tyrone's strand does not count toward that trophy.
steps: Follow Tyrone's assignments through the strand.
Finish the finale for its separate award.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: After Down to Earth in Chapter 1, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept meditation before the encounter disappears. Its necessity is unconfirmed: do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops; there is no mission replay or New Game Plus. Bring your partner to outdoor spots so both characters receive credit. Complete all 18 spots for this trophy, even though 100% completion only requires 15.
steps: Keep a manual Chapter 1 save; 15 manual slots are available.
After Down to Earth, accept Lucia's morning balcony meditation.
Bring your partner to outdoor spots and complete all 18.
Retain the Chapter 1 save until the award unlocks.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Play as Jason and take Bret Vogel's hunting assignments through his target decks. Use a clean head or heart shot to preserve the carcass. One unique animal meets this trophy; continue through all 15 decks for completion, with cleanup available after the story.
steps: Take Bret's hunting assignment as Jason.
Hunt the unique target with a clean shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect enough cards to complete three whole sets, rather than counting three individual cards. Continue the collection toward 15 of the 18 sets if you are following the 100% route. This is free-roam cleanup without a story deadline.
steps: Fill three complete card sets.
Continue to 15 sets for the completion checklist.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 different locations while exploring the state. Track location visits separately from vehicle scans, which advance Whip It Good instead. The same 100 locations are needed for completion, and remaining visits can be made after the campaign.
steps: Use WAiNK at distinct locations as you explore.
Reach 100 locations, separately from your vehicle discoveries.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Open Progress > Challenges and choose unfinished entries until 50 are complete. Repeating an already completed entry does not replace clearing a new challenge. Continue to 70 of the 80 challenges for completion; these can be finished in cleanup.
steps: Select unfinished entries under Progress > Challenges.
Finish 50 for the trophy and 70 for completion.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Bring your partner on a vault robbery to trigger a four-star response, then escape together. Keep going beyond the red heat zone after losing the immediate police search. Clearing only the flashing search area is insufficient, and the attempt can be repeated in free roam.
steps: Bring your partner and generate a four-star pursuit.
Escape together beyond the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner and rob three shops while police pursuit remains active. If the stars fade and only the heat zone remains, start the chain again. Allow about 30 seconds after the third shop for the award; this can be retried after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner.
Rob three shops without losing the active Wanted Level.
Allow the delayed unlock after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan unfamiliar vehicles through WAiNK while travelling between missions. A scan counts as discovering a vehicle, so use traffic to build the collection naturally. Reach 100 for this trophy and 200 base models for completion; neither tally has a chapter deadline.
steps: Scan unfamiliar traffic with WAiNK.
Reach 100 discoveries, then continue toward 200 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Find grouped gang guards at an illegal operation and equip an assault rifle. Press L3 and R3 while aiming to enter Combat Focus, then defeat five enemies before that use ends. Adrenaline extends the window, and you can retry during free roam.
steps: Prepare an assault rifle near a group of gang guards.
Activate Focus while aiming and defeat five enemies in that use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Save before entering VCIA and steal a large passenger plane connected to a boarding bridge; gates E3 and E4 work. Reverse toward the runway, take off and fly about a kilometre away for the delayed award. Remote parked planes do not count, but this free-roam attempt is not missable.
steps: Save, then take a bridge-docked passenger plane at E3 or E4.
Reverse to the runway and take off.
Fly about a kilometre away for the delayed unlock.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Make a manual save before visiting Mile Zero Air Station on the far southwestern island. Look on the south side for a parked Rhino, enter it, then drive and fire until the award registers. You can return in free roam, so this is not a chapter-limited encounter.
steps: Save before approaching the south side of Mile Zero Air Station.
Enter a Rhino and drive and fire until the award registers.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to obtain the Snap Gun. At Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City, use it on the locked back door, find the safe-code note inside the back room, then empty the safe and leave unseen. Kicking the door triggers the alarm; reload if detected, or retry later in free roam.
steps: Unlock the Snap Gun through Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
Open the locked back door quietly and read the safe-code note.
Empty the safe and leave unseen; reload if spotted.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Complete That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4 to unlock vault jobs. Follow an armored security van to a large bank and enter while the guard opens the vault. Bring your partner to carry bags and escape the immediate four-star response; repeat for five vaults, or all eight for completion. These jobs remain available for cleanup.
steps: Unlock vault jobs near the end of Chapter 4.
Tail a security van and enter the opened vault with your partner.
Rob five vaults and escape; continue to eight for 100%.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck during free roam, then escape the police response. Continue beyond the red heat zone rather than stopping when the immediate search ends. The award checks the completed escape, and you can make another attempt after the campaign.
steps: Rob an armored truck in free roam.
Escape beyond the heat zone, not only the immediate search.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Travel through unexplored parts of Leonida while collecting items and doing side missions. Use the in-game exploration progress to find what remains rather than assuming an area total. The research does not establish a precise region count, and exploration can be completed after the story.
steps: Visit unexplored map areas while doing other cleanup.
Use in-game exploration progress to find remaining coverage.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Track the owner of each illegal operation and rob one belonging to each of the nine gangs. Repeating operations from the same gang does not cover a new owner. Continue through all 39 operations for completion; remaining robberies can be done after the story.
steps: Track gang ownership and rob an operation from each gang.
Cover all nine gangs, then finish all 39 operations for completion.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The official description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but the exact trigger is still being confirmed. The research does not verify a venue or interaction sequence. Leave this on the free-roam cleanup list rather than treating a guessed location as fact.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description calls for a classic-style escape from a vehicle showroom, but the exact trigger is still being confirmed. No particular car, showroom or exit is verified in the research. It is not flagged as missable, so keep it for cleanup pending a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit Kingpin Bowling, the illegal operation encountered in Chapter 2, with Sticky Bombs. Take the office luxury watch, the shotgun on a table and the office safe contents, blasting the safe open before escaping police. This is a robbery rather than a bowling match; the operation returns if valuables remain, so it is not missable.
steps: Bring Sticky Bombs to the Kingpin Bowling operation.
Collect the watch, shotgun and safe contents.
Escape police; return if anything was left behind.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Buy a gym membership and train with your partner so both characters work out alongside each other. Raise both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength, rather than improving only one character. You can finish their training in post-story free roam.
steps: Buy gym access and bring your partner to train.
Maximize Strength for both Jason and Lucia.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile, including robberies and fights. Work through the rest of the completion route before considering a separate grind, since those activities naturally contribute. This is cumulative and can be finished after the campaign.
steps: Build Criminal Profile actions through robberies and fights.
Finish the route before topping up the cumulative 500 actions.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The exact trigger is still being confirmed, and the description does not identify an activity to retry. Do not assume any generic second attempt is sufficient or grind unrelated retries. Keep this non-missable award on the cleanup list until a verified method is available.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The exact trigger is still being confirmed, with no specific encounter or location established by the research. The vague official description is not enough to turn a theory into a route. Leave this non-missable award for cleanup pending a sourced method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description specifies a melee drive-by, but the exact trigger is still being confirmed. A required vehicle, target count and input sequence are not verified. Do not treat an ordinary collision as the established method; this remains a non-missable cleanup item.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Collect marked bills from bank and payday-loan jobs, then sell them through your contacts to launder them. Build the cumulative total to $250,000 across multiple jobs. This also advances the fencing requirement for completion and can be finished after the story.
steps: Gather marked bills from bank and payday-loan jobs.
Sell through contacts until the cumulative total reaches $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 on shop purchases while equipping your characters. Purchases across different shop types contribute, so no single transaction or store is required. Finish any remaining spending during free-roam cleanup rather than forcing it early.
steps: Make useful purchases across shops while progressing.
Top up the cumulative spending total to $100,000 during cleanup.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to access Vice City Real Estate, then buy its eight purchasable garages. Budget roughly $160,000 in total; story-granted garages do not replace these purchases. The spaces also help with vehicle registration, and purchases remain available after the story.
steps: Complete Daily Driver and open Vice City Real Estate.
Purchase all eight garages, excluding story-granted properties.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Complete Moses in Chapter 2 to unlock Scooter Bros, then take a stolen car to Moses and choose Respray followed by Register. Each registration needs a free garage space, so buy garages first. From Chapter 3, fitting a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray is another option; register ten vehicles during free roam.
steps: Unlock Scooter Bros through Moses and ensure free garage space.
Bring a stolen car, choose Respray, then Register.
Repeat to ten registrations; Chapter 3 trackers offer another option.
